title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and updated docs site navigation and examples. No breaking API changes. Recommended release notes for users: see examples/redwood-examples/rag-agent-templates and docs/quickstarts/agent-tool-calling.
description: Motivation: Provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and end-to-end tool-calling quickstarts to help developers onboard faster and to standardize agent patterns across examples and docs. This PR introduces reusable agent templates (conversational RAG, extract-and-augment, multi-tool orchestration), a set of step-by-step quickstarts demonstrating function/tool calling with our streaming API, and docs site updates to surface the new content in the Quickstarts and Examples nav. Changes include code examples in Python/TS, demo data for local runs, and an updated examples README. Checklist: - [x] RAG agent templates added under redwood-examples/agents/templates - [x] Tool-calling quickstarts added in redwood-examples/quickstarts/tool-calling (Python + TS) - [x] Docs site nav updated and new quickstart pages added - [x] CI + example unit tests added and passing - [x] Sample prompts and eval harness hooks added for future quality monitoring Context: These templates are intended to be lightweight starting points for customers. They show recommended patterns for caching, safe tool invocation (rate limiting + validation), and fallbacks to smaller models when latency SLOs are missed. Related work: ENG-3248 (agent templates), PM-198 (quickstart requirements), earlier examples PRs pr-30745 and pr-30861. Migration notes: No runtime or API changes required by customers. The examples reference existing SDKs and the hosted API. How to review: Run the quickstarts locally (instructions in the examples README), verify the docs build (script docs/build.sh), and spot-check the demo prompts. Linking: Also updates redwood-docs site redirects for /quickstarts/agent-tool-calling.
